title: Saudi Arabian Bean Toast
description: A flavorful and satisfying breakfast dish inspired by Saudi Arabian cuisine. This recipe combines the goodness of beans and toast with a hint of salty flavor.

ingredients.name: white beans
ingredients.notes: canned or cooked beans are fine

ingredients.name: white toast
ingredients.notes: you can use whole wheat or other bread types as well

ingredients.name: salty
ingredients.notes: you can use salt or other salty seasonings like sumac

ingredients.name: arabian
ingredients.notes: use a mix of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon for a traditional flavor

ingredients.name: yummy
ingredients.notes: you can use olive oil or other neutral-tasting oil

instructions: 1. Cook the white beans according to package instructions or by boiling them in water.
2. Toast the white toast slices until they are lightly browned.
3. In a pan, heat the yummy (olive oil) over medium heat.
4. Add the salty (salt or sumac) and arabian (cumin, coriander, and cinnamon) spices to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
5. Add the cooked white beans to the pan and stir to combine with the spices.
6. Place the toasted white toast slices on a plate and top with the bean mixture.
